scope: Exact CPU shape replay of same per-user frontier/append-band/N-grouped coalescing scheduler; no model execution or arrival queue. Batch membership and padding come from the real population, not scaled small-sample means.
host_scope: Conditional host policy: one consumer spans append/prepare/score; directional paging batches group same actual length and field mask within that frontier. Resident GPU kernels measured elsewhere; host paging is not integrated or overlapped.
